notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 7.10
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to introduce our latest update, aimed at enhancing your gaming experience. In this version, we've worked tirelessly to bring significant improvements. We've reduced RAM usage and optimized frame rates, ensuring smoother performance. Various bugs have been squashed, and quality of life has been elevated. Moreover, we've trimmed down the game data size for more efficient storage and ramped up the game speed for a more dynamic play. Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these changes, and we hope you enjoy this enhanced version of our game!

Patch Notes: Version 7.10

Reduced RAM usage for smoother performance.
Optimized frame rates for a more seamless experience.
Enhanced overall gameplay for improved satisfaction.
Fixed various bugs to ensure a bug-free gaming environment.
Quality of life improvements for a better user experience.
Reduced game data size to optimize storage.
Increased game speed for a more dynamic and engaging play.

notes.title: July - What's Next?: Exciting Updates and Enhanced Gameplay
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We wanted to take a moment to thank you all for your continued support of our game. We've been hard at work on a number of new features and improvements, and we're excited to share some of them with you today.

Bug fixes and improvements have been the primary focus of our recent development efforts. We have addressed various issues reported by our dedicated community, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for all players. We appreciate your patience and feedback as we strive to make the game the best it can be.

Regarding the previous announcement about controller support, we have discovered that implementing it would require extensive changes to the game's core mechanics. After careful consideration, we have decided not to pursue controller support at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding.

On a positive note, we are actively working on other updates for the game. These updates will introduce exciting new content and enhancements that we can't wait to share with you. Stay tuned for further announcements in the coming weeks as we reveal more details.

Once again, we want to express our gratitude for your continued support and enthusiasm. Your feedback and engagement have been invaluable in shaping the game's direction. We hope you'll continue to enjoy playing and exploring the world of our game.

Thank you for being a part of this journey!

Calm Fox

notes.title: June - What's Next?: Controller Support
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings everyone![/b]

We wanted to take a moment to thank you all for your continued support of our game. We've been hard at work on a number of new features and improvements, and we're excited to share some of them with you today.

[b]Controller Support[/b]

One of the most requested features from our community has been controller support. We're happy to announce that we're currently testing and implementing controller support for the current version of the game. This will allow players to use a controller to play the game, which will be especially helpful for those who prefer to play games that way.

[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b]

[b]Other Updates[/b]

In addition, we're also working on a number of other updates for the game. Which will be revealed later on.

We'll be sharing more details about these updates in the coming weeks. In the meantime, we hope you'll continue to enjoy our game!

Thank you for your continued support!

Calm Fox.

notes.title: Play the Demo Now
notes.notes:
Play the Demo Now: Get a 10-Minute Sneak Peek with All Characters Unlockable on Our Upcoming Title!

What is  included ?

-10 minute of world 1  ( after 10 minute monsters become invulnerable )
-8 unlockable characters
-World 1 collectables
-Power up purchase

We're excited to announce that the demo for our upcoming title is now available to play! The demo guarantees 10 minutes of heart-pumping action, giving you a taste of what's to come in the full version.

But that's not all - we've also made sure that all characters are unlockable in the demo. You can unlock them all through gameplay.

We value your feedback and input on the game, and your comments will help us to make it even better as we approach its release. So, what are you waiting for? Download the demo now and experience the excitement for yourself!

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to hear your thoughts on the game!

notes.title: Mark Your Calendars: Early Access Date for Upcoming Title Revealed!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to share with you the official early access date for our upcoming title! We can't wait for you to get your hands on the game and share your feedback with us during the early access phase.

In the meantime, we'll be providing you with a demo of the game soon, so stay tuned for that!

We're excited to announce that the early access date for the game will be May 5th. Yes, that's right - it's the day after May the 4th! We couldn't resist the opportunity to make a pun, so we'll just say:

"May the 5th be with you."

We're dedicated to making this game the best it can be, and we're looking forward to your input during the early access phase. Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you in the game!
